liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (5 reviews): Reviewer's favorite of many seen: Scarlet Begonias flowing into Fire on the Mountain; Drums play double-time on this Scarlet, which includes one of Jerry's best solos on the song [24][26][28][29][34]
- **Looks Like Rain** (2 reviews): Reviewer says Looks Like Rain was very well sung in a basic but solid first set; Reviewer found Looks Like Rain a letdown after a ripping They Love Each Other [29][34]
- **Playin' In The Band** (2 reviews): Reviewer names Playin' as one of the reasons this show is essential, alongside Scarlet > Fire; Attendee considers Playin' in the Band a gem; drums and space were more jam-like than usual [25][28]
- **Minglewood Blues** (1 review): Phil took a short solo in Minglewood during the first set [30]
- **Tennessee Jed** (1 review): Garcia offset his hoarse voice with spiraling jams in the first set, notably Tennessee Jed [32]
- **China Doll** (1 other source): China Doll was on side B of the first-set cassette, so it is cut at the beginning [10]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-10-06.aud.Holtz-Bolton.Nak100s.112860.flac16** (recommended): audience recording; 20 songs; 145 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1984-10-06.167957.beyer.m160.vita.miller.clugston.fixed.167675.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 153 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1984-10-06.178333.nak304.thomas.miller.clugston.flac2496**: audience recording; 20 songs; 153 min [5]
- **gd1984-10-06.beyerm88.suraci.77750.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 150 min; rated 4/5 by 2 [10]
- **gd84-10-06.aud.unk.3160.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 19 songs; 152 min; rated 3.83/5 by 12 [15]. Said about its sound: Reviewer finds this recording far superior to the Nak 300 alternative; Reviewer says sound is not as good as the Nak shotgun-mic recordings [32][34]
- **gd84-10-06.nak.grace-cole.15573.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 151 min; rated 4.14/5 by 22 [16]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says the venue's acoustics were great and Brent and Phil played in tight sync [24]
- Jerry's voice was shot and he looked frustrated, yet attacked his guitar solos with evident determination [26]
- Attendee made the trip; says first set interplay of Brent and Jerry over Phil's steady bass was fantastic [28]
- During the post-space segment Jerry broke a string, and the band jammed while he fixed it [30]
- Reviewer attended the previous Charlotte show, which had sound problems, but missed Richmond [35]
- Reviewer ranks this Scarlet > Fire second only to the 5/8/77 version, with heavy effects on Jerry's guitar [25]
- Reviewer's first show was 3/26/87; says this show should be remembered for having the hottest Scarlet>Fire [29]
- At the time the show was widely trashed, a reputation lingering into the Taping Compendium; reviewer disagreed [35]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-10-06.aud.Holtz-Bolton.Nak100s.112860.flac16**: taped by Greg Holtz and Tony Bolton; transferred by Greg Holtz; source: Tapers: Greg Holtz, Tony Bolton, and Mark Kotyuk. Source: Nakamichi CM100s w/CP-4 Shotgun Capsules > FOB -> D-6 > MAC; [1]. Also: Derived from same master as shnid 92383; in 1998 master analog tape played on a Nakamichi deck into a Sony D-3 DAT [1]
- **gd1984-10-06.167957.beyer.m160.vita.miller.clugston.fixed.167675.flac2496**: taped by Jim Vita; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Jim Vita's Master (FOB) Audience Cassettes; Beyer M160 mics > Sony D5M (Maxell XLII-S) [2]
- **gd1984-10-06.178333.nak304.thomas.miller.clugston.flac2496**: taped by Stephen Thomas; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller; source: Stephen Thomas' Master Audience Cassettes; Nakamichi 300 mics + CP4 capsules > Sony D5M [5]. Also: Beyer M160 source patches crowd and opening notes of Looks Like Rain, plus bits of China Doll and Goin' Down The Road [5]
- **gd1984-10-06.beyerm88.suraci.77750.flac16**: taped by Tony Suraci; transferred by Tony Suraci; source: FOB/Beyer M88's>Sony D5M(XLIIS) [10]. Also: Recorded with Beyer M88 mics borrowed from Eugene D., run with his Sony D5; several patches were needed [10]
- **gd84-10-06.aud.unk.3160.sbeok.shnf**: Copy's lineage: Sennheiser 421 mics, Sony D5, DAT, then CDR; Info sheet says four first-disc tracks came from an alternate Nak CM300 source [33]
- **gd84-10-06.nak.grace-cole.15573.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB Nak 300 mics>Sony TCD5-M>DAT(via highly modified Sony ES)>CDR>EAC>CE2K>SHNTOOL>MKWACT [16]. Also: Reviewer received tapes of this show from taper John Cadwell days afterward [35]

claims.text: Reviewer's favorite of many seen: Scarlet Begonias flowing into Fire on the Mountain
Reviewer says the venue's acoustics were great and Brent and Phil played in tight sync
Reviewer ranks this Scarlet > Fire second only to the 5/8/77 version, with heavy effects on Jerry's guitar
Reviewer names Playin' as one of the reasons this show is essential, alongside Scarlet > Fire
Jerry's voice was shot and he looked frustrated, yet attacked his guitar solos with evident determination
Drums play double-time on this Scarlet, which includes one of Jerry's best solos on the song
Attendee made the trip; says first set interplay of Brent and Jerry over Phil's steady bass was fantastic
Attendee calls Scarlet into Fire on the Mountain smoking, with a phenomenal transition between them
Attendee considers Playin' in the Band a gem; drums and space were more jam-like than usual
Scarlet intro is described as lucid; Brent's keyboards stand out throughout the second set
Reviewer says Looks Like Rain was very well sung in a basic but solid first set
Reviewer's first show was 3/26/87; says this show should be remembered for having the hottest Scarlet>Fire
During the post-space segment Jerry broke a string, and the band jammed while he fixed it
Phil took a short solo in Minglewood during the first set
Reviewer finds this recording far superior to the Nak 300 alternative
Garcia offset his hoarse voice with spiraling jams in the first set, notably Tennessee Jed
Copy's lineage: Sennheiser 421 mics, Sony D5, DAT, then CDR
Info sheet says four first-disc tracks came from an alternate Nak CM300 source
Reviewer says sound is not as good as the Nak shotgun-mic recordings
Scarlet>Fire runs about 18 minutes, among the longest ever, according to the reviewer
Reviewer found Looks Like Rain a letdown after a ripping They Love Each Other
Reviewer received tapes of this show from taper John Cadwell days afterward
At the time the show was widely trashed, a reputation lingering into the Taping Compendium; reviewer disagreed
Reviewer attended the previous Charlotte show, which had sound problems, but missed Richmond
Derived from same master as shnid 92383; in 1998 master analog tape played on a Nakamichi deck into a Sony D-3 DAT
Master cassettes from Jim Vita, transferred by Charlie Miller; Beyer M160 source
Master cassette from Stephen Thomas, Nak 304 source, transferred by Charlie Miller
Beyer M160 source patches crowd and opening notes of Looks Like Rain, plus bits of China Doll and Goin' Down The Road
Recorded with Beyer M88 mics borrowed from Eugene D., run with his Sony D5; several patches were needed
China Doll was on side B of the first-set cassette, so it is cut at the beginning
